programme.desc: Artful Bean. There’s easy money to be had in the art world and Mr. Bean is set on getting some of it. Once equipped with the right tools, he ventures into the countryside with a blank canvas in search of inspiration – and comes home with a painting full of life. Literally.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: The Fly. When Mr. Bean finds a fly in his room, it's war. He needs weapons. Fly spray? A rolled-up magazine? These are only the start. In desperation, he enlists a mouldy doughnut, an encyclopaedia, an upside-down dustbin and a club-hammer. Finally, Bean becomes the first man in history to wage war on a fly... with a fridge.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Pretend Patient. Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Window Of Opportunity. Mr Paliwal is organising the neighbours for a street clean so they can win “Britain’s Tidiest Street”. But when the window cleaner cancels, Mr Bean sees a money-making opportunity and offers to help. He invents his own mobile window-cleaning device which works brilliantly! But rushing around with a long cleaning pole and a wheelie bin full of water might not have been the best idea when everyone’s rushing around.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Game of Chicken. Fred gets a call for help from Chuck Mangum (JOHN VIENER), his daredevil of a best friend, leading the gang on a rescue mission deep in the caverns of an ancient civilization. Once there, they learn of the real mystery: the ghost of the Tribal Warrior that still protects the cavern from outsiders!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Poodle Justice. It's Scooby's dream come true as the gang visits the set of his favorite TV show and he meets the star, his celebrity crush, a dog actress who plays a detective on the screen. Now all Scooby has to do is work up the courage to actually talk to her while also solving the mystery of the monstrous Gargoyle attacking the production!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Be Quiet Scooby-Doo! To solve the mystery of a creepy Crystal Crawler - a bat-like cave monster - the Gang must venture into the Crystal Canopy - a labyrinth of intricate crystal formations. To make things worse, they can't speak a word while in the Canopy, because even the slightest sound will bring the crystals crashing down around them!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this 'bear's privilege,' except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: The Last Laugh. Red Herring complains to Tom and Jerry that he keeps hearing laughter everywhere he goes. Tom and Jerry bodyguard Red to prevent him from doing anything that might provoke laughter, but Red's goof-ups and fails soon have even them convulsed. Gradually, it gets loud enough that Tom and Jerry can hear it too. Will they find the true source of the laughter?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Eggstra Credit. Tom and Jerry awake to the smell of eggs being cooked in the kitchen – Ginger and Rick are making breakfast courtesy of their neighbor's fresh eggs. Ginger and Rick talk about how their new neighbor has a suburban henhouse and is raising their own produce. Tom and Jerry team up to target the henhouse for a heist, but it's easier said than done.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Kid Stuff. A little baby goat butts his head through a distant wall of the estate and starts nibbling the grass. At first, he helps Tom with the yardwork but then causes chaos throughout the manor. Tom and Jerry are left to deal with the kid.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: The Invisible Cat. On another scary night in the castle, The Invisible Cat wants nothing more than to catch mice. After it picks up and carries Jerry and Tuffy, Tom is really confused (and spooked) to see the two mice "magically" float through the air! When Tom accidentally smacks The Invisible Cat in the face and knocks Jerry and Tuffy free of his hold, it sparks a slapstick fight between the two cats.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Costume Party Smarty. As Rick and Ginger prepare for a costume party, Tom tries to score some snacks. Jerry and Tuffy are out to do the same. Spike and Tom are initially confused by the guests' costumes. Determined to get their paws on as much party food as they can, however, they contrive their own costumes to crash the party. Will they get away with it?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Catching Some Z's. On the outskirts of Catsylvania, zombie cats pop up out of the ground as Tom passes a cemetery, so Tom runs to Jerry Van Mouseling for help. At first, the mouse thinks Tom is a zombie cat or Frankenstein-cat and tries repelling him. However, once Jerry understands the problem, he and his band of angry peasant mice help fight the zombie cats.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series III
programme.desc: Mr Bean returns for a third series of his animated adventures. Featuring in 26 brand new episodes. This series follows Mr Bean, his best friend Teddy and his long-suffering landlady Mrs Wicket as we witness more of the mishaps that surround Mr Bean's daily life. Mr Bean becomes obsessed with computer gaming, prevents Mrs. Wicket from selling her house, builds his own caravan, rescues a football from a haunted house and finds himself in many other hilarious escapades. All voiced by Rowan Atkinson.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Opera For One. Irma calls Mr Bean to remind him about the Opera they are attending that night, but of course he has forgotten to buy tickets! He rushes to the box office, but they are sold out. So he hatches a plan to intercept the singer, Signor Parmigiano, at the train station and trick him into playing in his back garden – a private performance for just him and Irma!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Chocks Away. When his model aeroplane is blown out of the sky by that of a rival kid, Mr. Bean sets his sights on revenge. Next day, his newly constructed fighter plane, almost ready for take-off, sadly lacks a vital part – and the blinking model shop is shut! No matter. It’s chocks away with Teddy at the controls, fighting for airspace over London N10.

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Fish Bowl / At the Cinema / Coffee Shop. Tom has Jerry and Tuffy trapped in a fish bowl. / Tom is at the movies, Jerry and Tuffy pop out of his bucket of popcorn. / At a coffee shop, Jerry and Tuffy are eating a strawberry cake.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside a host of DC Super Heroes.

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: All Paws on Deck. Despite Velma's strong dislike of water, the Gang climb aboard the cruise ship run by Fred's cousin. But a water phobia is the least of their problems when a terrifying Sea Monster attacks the ship!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Screama Donna. To solve the mystery of a ghostly performer haunting her former venue, the Gang has to pretend to be a rock band themselves! But can they solve the case before Velma has to actually get on stage and sing?

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Party Time! Jerry sneaks into the party set up to steal some cheese while Tom is sleeping. Tom wakes up and chases Jerry across a table filled with all kinds of food. During the chase, Tom eats a melon which turns him into a sphere shape and Jerry eats a piece of cheese which turns him into a triangle shape.

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Witch. Lamput takes refuge in a spooky castle on the hill. The Docs, hot on Lamput's heels, find an unattended broomstick, and, typically, their first instinct is to use it to try to squish their orange quarry. But they quickly discover the broomstick has other, way cooler, uses. Before long the Docs are engaged in some high-speed, unlicenced magical broomstick-riding. Luckily for Lamput, the castle's owner steps in. She's green and witchy, and pretty annoyed about being disturbed from her moonbaking. When the docs break her magical broom, she flies into full witch-mode. Everyone gets transformed into frogs. Which, for Lamput, is a normal day at the office.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Clover and the Copycat. Traveling to the volcano, Min and Miguel encounter the island’s most fearsome predator: Big Rex! But instead of rampaging, he simply yawns as the ground trembles beneath them! The rumbling stops, replaced by the sound of a lullaby. Min and Miguel climb the volcano to uncover the source, leaving Clover and Tango to stand guard, where they encounter a Parasaur who mimics everything they do!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: A Sticky Situation. On a quest to gather the sweetest yum-yum plums on Dino Island, Uncle Jack shares his prized adventure journal with Jon, a record of every journey he’s taken across the island! Every page tells a story of courage and discovery, except one! The far side of the volcano remains blank! Determined to be the first to fill that empty page, Jon rallies Min and Miguel to join him on a bold new expedition!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Autograph Hunter. When Mr Bean discovers that his favourite TV action star is in town, he takes a photo to be autographed – but the queue to meet him is massive! So, using a couple of props, he disguises himself as a security guard to get to the front – but he is caught out. How will Mr Bean get his autograph before TV star rushes off to catch his plane?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Scrapper's Feeding Time. Mrs Wicket is off for the weekend, and insists Mr Bean feed her cat Scrapper at 5am and 5pm every day. The evenings are OK, but Mr Bean can’t face getting up at dawn every day just for a cat! So he plugs his old train set into a timer, set to deliver Scrapper’s food at the required times. But by unplugging Mrs Wicket’s timers, her lamps don’t activate and some burglars spot an opportunity…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: The Sofa Stain. Irma and Mr Bean are invited across the road for dinner, and Mr Paliwal is particularly keen to show off his brand-new white sofa. As Mr Bean tests it out, he feels the squish of a chocolate bar in his back pocket and realises it’s gone all over the white cushions. Can Mr Bean clean the sofa before anyone notices?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Toothache. Bean’s sweet tooth leads him to despair when he bites off a bit more than he can chew. He is tormented by the toothache from Hell - and embarks on a hilarious mission to pull out this menace. Bean’s DIY attempts fail to succeed, and he is left with no other choice but to visit the dreaded dentist. But can Bean brave the Dentist’s chair? Or will the dentist despair when faced with Bean’s antics?

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Growing Impatient. The Baby Lemmings discover that a little water and a little sunlight can make seeds grow. They're amazed. Baby Lynx would like to join in the gardening, but her eagerness means she ruins the fragile little sprout. The Baby Lemmings decide to do a little vegetable garden of their own. Annoyed, Baby Lynx decides to challenge them to a competition for the most beautiful garden!

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Lightning-fast move. As the storm rages, Baby Owl's tree is struck by lightning! She's left without a nest. The Baby Lemmings seek shelter from the wind, and find refuge in a crumbling cave. They decide to decorate it in a makeover style. Unintentionally, they take the items Baby Owl had prepared for her new nest. She comes to get them back, but the Baby Lemmings don't understand why.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Hazelnut slide. Baby Chipmunk is trying to carry a ton of nuts back to her den, but climbing down the cliff with all her nuts is proving a complex task. As for the baby lemmings, they've discovered the principle of the slide and are having fun building a longer and longer one. When the baby chipmunk sees this, she sees a great opportunity to get her nuts down more cheaply.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Follow the hilarious, heroic and mischievous Bugs Bunny in a series of slapstick comedic shorts that find the carrot-loving rabbit matching his wits against classic characters such as Theodore "Tasmanian" Devil, Wile E. Coyote and Yosemite Sam. Along the way, Bugs encounters brand-new foes but he has some help from new friends like Bigfoot and Squeaks the Squirrel!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry Gokko
programme.desc: Food Fight. Jerry is raiding the fridge but gets caught by Tom. Tom tries to get the food back, but Jerry and Tuffy fight back by throwing food at Tom. Jerry accidentally throws Tuffy at Tom and has to rescue him.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Me, Myself and A.I. When an Artificial Intelligence takes over the building of a trendy tech company, the gang has to solve the computerized mystery - and maybe learn a lesson about relying too much on technology.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Gremlin on a Plane. The Gang has seats on the largest airplane ever to fly the open airways! Unfortunately, the plane is also beset by a Gremlin bent on sabotaging the flight! The Gang has to step up to solve the airborne mystery as well as deal with something even scarier: Daphne in the pilot seat!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Sofa. Mr. Bean likes nothing more than to relax on his sofa with a good meal and his favourite telly programme. Unfortunately, a painful explosion of springs under his bottom puts an end to that. He sets about buying another one… but, alas, sofas are expensive items. TV dinners may well be a thing of the past for Mr Bean.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Home Movie. Mr Bean is unimpressed with a horror movie he sees at the cinema and reckons he can do much better. Bean sets out to create his very own home movie masterpiece –featuring Mrs Wicket Irma and Teddy! The screening in the garden is a huge success but will Mrs Wicket be pleased with her makeover and starring role?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Wrap Star. Skullie warns Tom that it's almost midnight, so he'd best be on alert for one of the Catsylvania ghouls to show up. Tom reaches for a towel to wipe the soap out of his eyes but is shocked to discover that he's not using a towel at all, but a Mummy-cat's wrap! Soon, the Mummy-cat finds ways to freak out Tom and befuddle him, Jerry and Tuffy all over the house.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Perfume Party. Hoping to woo Toodles, Tom decides to make some homemade perfume for her. He throws in many unusual ingredients and gets a surprisingly pleasant outcome, getting the attention he craved. However, soon Tom and Jerry must come up with a plan when the heavenly scent turns bad.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Charm School Dropouts. When Tom and Butch both arrive to ask out Toodles, their competitive behavior prompts her to send them away to a charm school she recently attended. But how will they fare in the grueling etiquette courses taught by elegant cat instructors?

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: Kai, Finn, and Mia find themselves thrust into the adventure of their lives when Enigma calls upon them to travel to Kaboom City.

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders II
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders brings the wackiness, humor and slapstick we've grown to love to a new preschool audience. At ACME Construction Company, Bugs Bunny and Lola Bunny manage a crew of builders that, quite frankly, should not be anywhere near a construction site. However, by working together as a team, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Tweety and others use their tools and wild vehicles to pull off some of the looniest construction jobs ever.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: All You Can Eat. Mr Bean has forgotten he's supposed to be cooking dinner for his long-suffering girlfriend Irma. He dashes to the supermarket to buy some groceries but why buy food when you can win an entire trolley full in an All You Can Eat Competition? But Mr Bean has some stiff competition - no one can eat one of Mr Magg’s pies quicker than Mr Maggs himself. Mr Bean has to think fast to win. But after all that eating will Bean still be in the mood to cook a romantic meal?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Flat Pack. Mr Bean is in need of a sturdy new bookcase and sets off to visit a furniture warehouse. He finds one that’s perfect but is outraged when he’s told he has to build the bookcase himself! Bean is unfamiliar with flat pack assembly and struggles to construct his new bookcase failing miserably when he discovers he’s one screw short. Mr Bean heads back to the shop only to find it’s closed!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: The Big Shrink. When Irma leaves Mr Bean in charge of her knitwear stall, he manages to tip all the jumpers into a muddy puddle. Panicking, he decides to take them all home to clean them in his washing machine. But somehow he ends up shrinking them all, so tries all sorts of ways to stretch them back to their original size before Irma finds out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Winning Ticket. Mr Bean spots a cool remote-controlled car Mr Paliwal is selling at a yard sale, so he sets up a tombola with his own stuff as prizes to raise some cash. He’s raffling off some not very good things from his flat - the star prize however is his green car, so lots of people are buying tickets hoping to win the car. But Mr Bean has rigged the tombola so that the car can’t be won. Will he get away with it?

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings IV
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this "bear's privilege" except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Alarm Bean. Mr Bean and Teddy are looking forward to seeing a once-in-a-lifetime comet – but it won’t appear until 4am! He tries to stay up, but it’s useless – he keeps dropping off. So instead, Mr Bean decides to go to bed and set an alarm – yet he over-winds the clock and it breaks! With all the shops closed, his only option is to build his own complicated version to make sure he doesn’t miss the comet…

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Operation Wicket. Mrs Wicket makes Mr Bean drive her to the hospital to get her ingrown toenail seen to and asks him to wait. Mr Bean gets bored, and on a wander around the hospital he finds a spare doctor’s outfit with stethoscope – great Teddy - I’ll give you a check-up! But a nurse spots him, and thinking he’s a new doctor Mr Bean is asked to visit patients. How long can he keep it up before he’s found out?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Supermarket Ride. Mr Bean is at the supermarket when he spots a cool fire engine ride – but the security guard makes it clear it’s for little kids only. Not to be deterred, Mr Bean tries everything he can to distract the guard to have his go on the ride. When he finally does get his go, it’s not as good as he thought it would be, especially when a real fire engine has to be called to help Mr Bean!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean’s Blooms. Mr Bean receives a delivery of a bunch of flowers for Mrs Wicket, but accidentally runs them over in the his car. He can’t afford to replace them, so he decides to recreate the bunch by taking flowers one by one from anywhere he can - a vase in a café, a wedding bouquet, even from between the teeth of a tango dancer! But will he assemble the bunch and be back in time for Mrs Wicket?

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Future Tense. Skinny might be a man of science, but he’s more than happy to get his fortune told for a laugh. The palm-reader sees alarming visions of Skinny’s near future; mostly visions that relate to Skinny being squashed, smooshed or otherwise smeared. It’s kind of Skinny’s own fault; maybe if he paid a bit less attention to chasing Lamput and a bit more attention to not getting squashed, smooshed or smeared, he wouldn’t need constant rescuing by a frazzled mystic.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Moley is a lively animated comedy series for children and families of all ages. It follows the underground adventures of a charmingly optimistic young mole, Moley. As the keeper of The Mystical Manual of Magic — known more affectionately as “Manny,” Moley is forever embarking on comedic, zany, Moletastic and thrilling magical adventures which are filled with heart, to help the citizens of the bustling city of MoleTown. What Moley lacks in physical prowess and smarts, he makes up for in heart and friendship! So, with his friends Dotty, a plucky, adventure-seeking mole, Mishmosh, an oddball inventor mole, Mona Lisa, the sensible grounded Mole and Mystic Mole, a wise old mole who knows more than he lets on - there’s no challenge Moley can’t mishandle-- but then soon overcome!

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and the Mushables follows the comedy adventures of the Mushable community as together they put the fun back into fungi! As pocket-sized Guardians of the Forest, each Mushable has a special gift; while Mush-Mush can communicate with nature, Lilit shines bright like the light and Chep has an impressive memory. As they get to know thier talents and their limits, the Mushables find there is still a lot to discover about growing up! A fun journey of self-discovery, exciting outdoor adventure and mush mush more!

programme.desc: Mush-Mush and the Mushables follows the comedy adventures of the Mushable community as together they put the fun back into fungi! As pocket-sized Guardians of the Forest, each Mushable has a special gift; while Mush-Mush can communicate with nature, Lilit shines bright like the light and Chep has an impressive memory. As they get to know thier talents and their limits, the Mushables find there is still a lot to discover about growing up! A fun journey of self-discovery, exciting outdoor adventure and mush mush more!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: The Day of Chaos. Thanks to the Titan Fury, Kid Fury defeats his friends. But Mr. King takes control of the robot and threatens to destroy Kaboom City.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Vampire State. On the edge of the village of Catsylvania, a bat snatches up Tom by his tail. He is carried off to a castle in the mountains and emerges in a full Dracula cape and fangs. The real Dracula appears and demands a snack. Tom swoops down on a tiny mouse village, scaring the villagers and carrying off a few. An angry mob with torches and rakes call on Jerry Van Mouseling to go rescue their kin.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Hamster Hoopla. After Ginger keeps an abandoned pet hamster unbeknown to Rick, Jerry takes its place after the hamster scurries off. However, Jerry soon gets displaced by baby hamsters that keep multiplying. Soon the situation is out of control.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Tuff Shooting. Under-Butler Tom helps the Lord of the Manor have a trouble-free afternoon hunting with his guests shooting skeet, and Tom's only job is to keep handing clay birds to the head butler. But Tom gets distracted when he sees Jerry and Tuffy eating the fabulous spread of food for the Lord's guests! Tom is so mad he abandons his duty and rushes Jerry and Tuffy, leading to an epic chase.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Stolen Heart. When a gorgeous feline walks into the Cat and Mouse Detective Agency, Tom is immediately smitten. But someone has already stolen her heart—a heart-shaped cake made for a gangster and his fiancée on their upcoming engagement. He asked for the expensive engagement ring to be baked into the batter as a Valentine's Day surprise, but the cake and the jewelry were stolen from the bakery window.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Anger Mismanagement. Inside the house, Tom and Jerry get into a full-on brawl. Steam comes out of their ears as they face off. Just then, Ginger and Rick walk in, grab both by the scruff of their necks, and says they have to learn to deal with their anger. Ginger shoves a copy of an anger management book at them. Spike and Tom both roll their eyes but agree to make an effort.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside a host of DC Super Heroes.

programme.title: Batwheels III
programme.desc: A Purr-fect Pair. When the rambunctious Kitty insists on joining Redbird on a covert mission to tail King Tut, Red worries things could get out of hand.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Clover and the Copycat. Traveling to the volcano, Min and Miguel encounter the island’s most fearsome predator: Big Rex! But instead of rampaging, he simply yawns as the ground trembles beneath them! The rumbling stops, replaced by the sound of a lullaby. Min and Miguel climb the volcano to uncover the source, leaving Clover and Tango to stand guard, where they encounter a Parasaur who mimics everything they do!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: A Sticky Situation. On a quest to gather the sweetest yum-yum plums on Dino Island, Uncle Jack shares his prized adventure journal with Jon, a record of every journey he’s taken across the island! Every page tells a story of courage and discovery, except one! The far side of the volcano remains blank! Determined to be the first to fill that empty page, Jon rallies Min and Miguel to join him on a bold new expedition!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Mime Games. A leisurely stroll in the park turns into a run when Mr. Bean is chased home by an angry Mime Artist. He is lost for more words than usual when the street performer makes himself at home and insists on being wined and dined. Bean ousts the pest from his house using the only language mime artists understand.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Spring Clean. It's the First Day of Spring and Mr. Bean sets about washing his clothes, his furniture, his teddy and himself. But, alas, there’s no hot water! A bit of inventive improvisation with an outside drainpipe proves Mr. Bean to be greener at D.I.Y. plumbing than he thought.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Irma’s Surprise. When Mr Bean forgets Irma’s birthday, he asks Divya to help him build a snow sculpture in her likeness. It looks great, but the sun comes out and the sculpture starts to melt. Mr Bean decides to take it into his flat to protect it from the sun – but even that isn’t working. Will he be able to keep it frozen until Irma arrives?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: A Day In Bed. Mr Bean and Teddy have no plans, so decide to stay in bed all day. Mr Bean is determined that his feet can’t touch the ground, so he pushes the bed around with a broom. He has to find ingenious ways to make his tea and toast for breakfast, brush his teeth and an even bigger challenge of ordering a pizza and collecting it from downstairs without getting out of bed!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: All Paws on Deck. Despite Velma's strong dislike of water, the Gang climb aboard the cruise ship run by Fred's cousin. But a water phobia is the least of their problems when a terrifying Sea Monster attacks the ship!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Screama Donna. To solve the mystery of a ghostly performer haunting her former venue, the Gang has to pretend to be a rock band themselves! But can they solve the case before Velma has to actually get on stage and sing?

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: If You Can't Scooby-Doo the Time Don't Scooby-Doo the Crime. Fred is excited to visit The Vault - a high security prison from which no convict has ever escaped. But when the ghost of Stealing Stan (JOHN DiMAGGIO), an inmate who always claimed to be innocent, terrorizes the prison, Fred has to solve the mystery and rethink his stance on criminal justice!

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this 'bear's privilege,' except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: You Are What You Eat. Rick and Ginger wake up late and, in their hurry, they accidentally put dog food in Tom's bowl and cat food in Spike's. This causes Spike to behave like a cat and Tom to act like a dog. Although they're confused at first, they soon eat other types of food and discover how it makes them act.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: The iconic cat and mouse rivals are back. The all-new series takes another look at the madcap slapstick and never-ending battle that has made Tom and Jerry two of the most beloved characters of all time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Not My Tyke. Spike orders Tom and Jerry to watch Tyke while he's away, but instead Tom takes the opportunity to chase Jerry in the backyard. Suddenly, Tyke is nowhere to be seen and the front gate is wide open! Tom and Jerry must find the pup in time or face Spike's beating.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: A Head For Science. On the edge of the village of Catsylvania, Tom is carried off to Dr. Frankenstein's castle lab. Several lightning bolts later, a monster comes to life: a nine-foot-tall hulk with Tom's relatively tiny head sewn on. Frankenstein orders the monster to go terrorize the village, but it has problems focusing after Tom's head sees Jerry in the lab.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Everyone Into the Pool. When Tom and Jerry go to a pool party at Toodles's place, Tom shows off in the pool with ridiculous stunts. Butch and Meathead arrive, adding more rivalry to the party. Soon, Toodles suggests they play a game of water polo, which reaches a fever pitch before long.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Double Dog Trouble. Spike the bulldog comes to Tom and Jerry, complaining he is being harassed by unknown creditors, ex-girlfriends, and other problems due to identity theft. They take the case on and go in search of who could be using Spike's name. It quickly becomes equally confusing for them to sort out.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series III
programme.desc: Mr Bean returns for a third series of his animated adventures. Featuring in 26 brand new episodes. This series follows Mr Bean, his best friend Teddy and his long-suffering landlady Mrs Wicket as we witness more of the mishaps that surround Mr Bean's daily life. Mr Bean becomes obsessed with computer gaming, prevents Mrs. Wicket from selling her house, builds his own caravan, rescues a football from a haunted house and finds himself in many other hilarious escapades. All voiced by Rowan Atkinson.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean Hatches A Plan. Jealous of Mr Paliwal’s new egg-laying chicken, Mr Bean heads off to the local farm to get himself one. But after causing havoc at the coop, he comes home with the wrong chicken – not only will it not lay eggs, but it turns out Mrs Wicket is allergic to feathers so Mr Bean has to keep the chicken well hidden!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Royal Bean. When Mr. Bean breaks his favourite Royal mug he discovers there's only one place to buy a replacement: Buckingham Palace, home of the Queen of England. When one of Her Majesty's corgis runs off with his teddy, Bean gives chase through secret tunnels… and gets lost.

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: Trading Chases. Fred switches places with Jeff, the tour guide at a history museum, to give him a chance to lead the Gang in solving a mystery. The mystery: a frightening Egyptian crocodile deity is terrorizing the museum. The problem: Fred is instantly jealous of this new guy and sets out to solve the mystery before Jeff can - with the help of Jeff's tour group of children!

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Date Night. It's Specs big night in the town with the lady of his dream. What could go wrong? The answer to that question might have do with the shapeshifting orange blob at the next table.

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Clara and the Baby Croc. Alone in the jungle, Clara Tinhorn wrestles with her loneliness, until she stumbles upon a freshly hatched baby crocodile!She names the hatchling Lenny, and the two quickly bond in playful joy! When the Ranchers arrive to check on the crocodile nest, they discover the baby is gone! Furious, the mother croc, Snapfang, unleashes her wrath on the Ranchers, convinced they’ve stolen her child!

programme.title: Dino Ranch: Island Explorers
programme.desc: Treasure Trouble. The Ranchers dive deep across the ocean floor, determined to track down Jack’s long-lost rusty anchor! Their search is a success, but the moment they reach for it, the water explodes with motion! A massive plesiosaur charges at them, sending the Ranchers close to the wreck of an ancient ship! Just when a collision seems certain, the beast halts, spooked by something lurking in the depths!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Bean The Pet Groomer. When Mrs Wicket gives Mr Bean some cash to take Scrapper to the pet groomer’s, he can’t believe the cost! Instead he buys a basic grooming kit, pockets the rest of the cash and gives the cat a makeover himself, without Mrs Wicket realising. Spotting a business opportunity, Mr Bean then sets himself up as a pet groomer in the back garden. But Mrs Wicket discovers she’s been tricked and now she wants revenge!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Pretend Patient. Mr Bean is settling in for his favourite TV show marathon when Irma rings to remind him they’re having lunch at her mum’s. He pretends to be ill, which backfires when Irma comes over to look after him – but soon he’s taking advantage of Irma who is waiting on him hand and foot. It’s all going great until Irma’s mum turns up and starts to take charge; no TV, no popcorn and worst of all – no Teddy!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Home Movie. Mr Bean is unimpressed with a horror movie he sees at the cinema and reckons he can do much better. Bean sets out to create his very own home movie masterpiece –featuring Mrs Wicket Irma and Teddy! The screening in the garden is a huge success but will Mrs Wicket be pleased with her makeover and starring role?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Dinner for two. Mr. Bean forgets the golden rule: never fall asleep in the bath when you've got a chicken in the oven. So what romantic meal can he quickly rustle-up for his luckless girlfriend, Irma Gobb? The cheese from the mousetrap? The flower from the vase? A meal is eventually provided by an uninvited guest.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Folding over backwards. Today, Baby Raccoon has decided to iron all the tree leaves in the forest so that they lie flat, and pile them up in a neat heap. This new obsession allows the Baby Lemmings to discover the joys of origami. But there's a lot of failure in the Baby Lemmings' work, as they leave the crumpled leaves on the ground, unknowingly destroying Baby Raccoon's work.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Parkour Forever. Baby Lemmings cross a small obstacle course to get to the other side of a body of water. The Baby Lemmings find the course super fun! They get into the spirit of the game and enjoy completing the course over and over again. Baby Lynx discovers the course, but in crossing it she destroys it completely! The game is ruined for the Baby Lemmings, who set off in search of a new place to make the obstacle course even more fun.

programme.title: Baby Lemmings
programme.desc: Down to the Wire. The Baby Lemmings meet a spider and his web, which allows them to play like baby Spider-Man. They even develop a tree climbing course in the forest. Baby Beaver, for his part, has a hard time fitting branches together to build a bridge over the river. When he sees the construction possibilities offered by the lemmings' spider, he decides to steal it from them.

programme.title: New Looney Tunes
programme.desc: Follow the hilarious, heroic and mischievous Bugs Bunny in a series of slapstick comedic shorts that find the carrot-loving rabbit matching his wits against classic characters such as Theodore "Tasmanian" Devil, Wile E. Coyote and Yosemite Sam. Along the way, Bugs encounters brand-new foes but he has some help from new friends like Bigfoot and Squeaks the Squirrel!

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: With high school over, Shaggy, Scooby, Velma, Daphne and Fred decide to travel during what could be their last summer break together. The gang hits the road in the Mystery Machine, chasing fun and adventure.

programme.title: Be Cool, Scooby-Doo!
programme.desc: With high school over, Shaggy, Scooby, Velma, Daphne and Fred decide to travel during what could be their last summer break together. The gang hits the road in the Mystery Machine, chasing fun and adventure.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series
programme.desc: Treasure! In a dark and cobwebby corner of his attic, Mr. Bean finds a treasure map. The hunt is on! But tricky clues lead Bean up the chimney, round the bend, down the garden path, up the blinking wall and nearly all the way to Australia.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Fish Sitting. Mr Bean has to look after Mrs Wicket’s pet goldfish while she is away. With a ravenous Scrapper sniffing around Bean ends up becoming more bodyguard than babysitter. But when he manages to lose his fishy friend Mr Bean takes a nightmare journey down the sewer and back to his neighbour’s house via the park. Can Mr Bean get the pesky pet back in the bowl before Mrs Wicket returns home?

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Driven Crazy. Things go awry when Cates orders Tom to clean and inspect the family automobile. Tom, Jerry and Tuffy end up taking the car into the countryside and doing their best to control it. As Tom reads and attempts to follow the instruction manual, Jerry and Tuffy help, but they also suffer many near-misses.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: The iconic cat and mouse rivals are back. The all-new series takes another look at the madcap slapstick and never-ending battle that has made Tom and Jerry two of the most beloved characters of all time.

programme.title: The Tom and Jerry Show III
programme.desc: Saddle Soreheads. Bedfordshire Bertie, a champion show horse, runs away and hides on the estate grounds, where Jerry does his best to help her hide from nosey Tom. Bertie is stressed out over a big upcoming meet, but Jerry has a calming effect on her. When Tom catches up with them, he, too, helps the horse overcome her nerves and get back to her old self.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this 'bear's privilege,' except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: SuperThings: Rivals of Kaboom - Kazoom Power
programme.desc: Kai, Finn, and Mia find themselves thrust into the adventure of their lives when Enigma calls upon them to travel to Kaboom City.

programme.title: Batwheels II
programme.desc: Batwheels, a preschool animated action-adventure comedy series starring the most heroic and iconic vehicles from the DC universe. They are a team of incredible crimefighters who have banded together to oppose evil, combat crime and clean up the streets of Gotham City. They are...okay, they're NOT Batman and Robin. They're the Batwheels - an awesome group of sentient super-powered crime-fighting vehicles defending Gotham City alongside Batman, Robin, Batgirl and a host of DC Super Heroes. Having just been created by the Batcomputer, our heroes are essentially kids with little to no life experience. Led by Bam (The Batmobile), the Batwheels - Bibi (The Batgirl Cycle), Red (The Redbird), Jett (The Batwing) and Buff (The Bat Truck) - must navigate the growing pains of being a newly formed super team as well as the growing pains that come with just being a kid.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders II
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders brings the wackiness, humor and slapstick we've grown to love to a new preschool audience. At ACME Construction Company, Bugs Bunny and Lola Bunny manage a crew of builders that, quite frankly, should not be anywhere near a construction site. However, by working together as a team, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig, Tweety and others use their tools and wild vehicles to pull off some of the looniest construction jobs ever.

programme.title: Bugs Bunny Builders: Hard Hat Time
programme.desc: Bugs Bunny Builders is a fun and exciting preschool series featuring your favorite Looney Tunes working at a construction company. Join Bugs Bunny, Lola Bunny, Daffy Duck, Porky Pig and Tweety Bird as they use their amazing vehicles to take on the looniest builds ever. Along the way, they’ll learn valuable lessons and never give up because The Looney Builders always get the job done!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: Holiday Teddy. Mr Bean decides to take Teddy on holiday to the seaside. But when he arrives at his hotel a spoilt little girl wants Teddy all for herself. And her protective dad only wants the best for his ‘princess’. An on-going tussle ensues between Mr Bean the little girl and her Dad resulting in a chase across the seaside town and onto the pier. No one comes between Mr Bean Teddy and their ‘relaxing’ holiday!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series II
programme.desc: The Newspaper. Mr Bean is left in peace when Mrs Wicket goes off on her holidays. This means Mr Bean has free access to her daily newspaper. But every time he goes down to collect it from the letterbox it disappears. Someone is taking it but who? Mr Bean is determined to nab the mysterious newspaper stealer and uses a range of ingenious homemade traps in his quest to catch the sneaky thief.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Train Trouble. Mr Bean is off on a train trip but loses his ticket as he waves goodbye to Irma on the platform, so has to find ways of escaping the eagle-eyed ticket inspector. He hides in the toilet, crawls under seats and even climbs into the luggage rack! But can he avoid her until he reaches his destination?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Blown Away. Mr Bean has cleared up the leaves in Mrs Wicket’s path using a leafblower, but can’t find anywhere to put the heap he’s created. So he uses the power tool to blow the pile of leaves in a neat bundle along the street to find somewhere to dump them. Things take a turn when he inadvertently manages to foil a bank robbery with his new toy.

programme.title: Grizzy and The Lemmings IV
programme.desc: In a vast natural reserve lost in the middle of the untamed wilderness, there is a small haven of human civilization: the forest ranger's house. Because he is (from his point of view) the most evolved animal on earth, the bear Grizzy feels it's only natural that the ranger's house becomes his territory as soon as its owner is away. No other animal dares to contest this "bear's privilege" except the most inoffensive, stupid and ridiculous mammal family that exists: the Lemmings - who also move into the house as soon as the ranger is gone. Grizzy and the Lemmings lead a merciless battle over the house in an atmosphere of total madness, where the two adversaries constantly try to outdo each other with nasty tricks!

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Drone Rescue. Mr Bean gets so engrossed playing with Mr Paliwal’s new drone that he doesn’t notice a car thief stealing his car. They quickly jump into Mr Paliwal’s car and use the drone to track the stolen car to the thief’s warehouse hideout. Using the drone, they discover a criminal car-stealing operation – but will they be able to outwit the car thieves using Mr Paliwal’s flying gadget?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Say Cheese! Irma is dragging a very bored Mr Bean around a shopping centre when he spots a competition for Minty Mints – pull your silliest face for a photo and win a cash prize! Mr Bean tries to queue but it’s too long - so he persuades Irma to visit a photo studio offering romantic photoshoots. Can Mr Bean get away with pulling funny faces and submit the photo to the Minty Mints people without Irma knowing?

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Tale Of Two Teddies. When Scrapper claws a rip in Teddy, Mr Bean rushes him to the Teddy hospital. As Teddy is being fixed, Mr Bean is rather taken with another Ted on sale in the shop. He decided to take Big Ted home with him once Teddy is fixed. But at home it seems as though Big Ted is freezing Teddy out, and after a particularly terrifying nightmare, Mr Bean realises he has to get rid of his new guest.

programme.title: Mr Bean: The Animated Series IV
programme.desc: Climbing Bean. Mr Bean takes Billy to a climbing centre but gets annoyed by a competitive dad who accuses him of being a beginner. Mr Bean insists he’s an expert but is made to prove it when they both compete for a trophy – the winner being the first to climb “The Big One”, a huge, scary wall for adults only! Mr Bean is determined to win but hadn’t counted on the competitive dad’s dirty tricks!

programme.title: Lamput III
programme.desc: Pup Mix. Lamput gets mistaken for a guide dog, and the Docs try to nab their quarry without disturbing an old lady's pleasant day in front of the wireless. Good thing she can't see the chaos going on.

programme.title: Moley
programme.desc: Moley is a lively animated comedy series for children and families of all ages. It follows the underground adventures of a charmingly optimistic young mole, Moley. As the keeper of The Mystical Manual of Magic — known more affectionately as “Manny,” Moley is forever embarking on comedic, zany, Moletastic and thrilling magical adventures which are filled with heart, to help the citizens of the bustling city of MoleTown. What Moley lacks in physical prowess and smarts, he makes up for in heart and friendship! So, with his friends Dotty, a plucky, adventure-seeking mole, Mishmosh, an oddball inventor mole, Mona Lisa, the sensible grounded Mole and Mystic Mole, a wise old mole who knows more than he lets on - there’s no challenge Moley can’t mishandle-- but then soon overcome!

So, with his friends Dotty, a plucky, adventure-seeking mole, Mishmosh, an oddball inventor mole, Mona Lisa, the sensible grounded Mole and Mystic Mole, a wise old mole who knows more than he lets on - there’s no challenge Moley can’t mishandle-- but then soon overcome!

programme.title: Tom and Jerry
programme.desc: Journey into the heart of Singapore with Tom and Jerry as they weave through the labyrinth of towering estates and skyscrapers and bask in the vibrant green of the urban jungle.

programme.title: Mush-Mush And The Mushables II
programme.desc: Mush-Mush and the Mushables follows the comedy adventures of the Mushable community as together they put the fun back into fungi! As pocket-sized Guardians of the Forest, each Mushable has a special gift; while Mush-Mush can communicate with nature, Lilit shines bright like the light and Chep has an impressive memory. As they get to know thier talents and their limits, the Mushables find there is still a lot to discover about growing up! A fun journey of self-discovery, exciting outdoor adventure and mush mush more!

programme.title: PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten V (37)
PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten V (38)
Neue Geschichten vom Pumuckl (11)
programme.desc: Eders ist nervös, als seine Jugendliebe Franziska ihn in der Werkstatt besucht. Ob er ihr bis heute Abend wohl ein Regal schreinern könnte? Flori kann. Und Pumuckl lässt ihn ausnahmsweise in Ruhe arbeiten, weil Eder ihm Kaiserschmarrn versprochen hat. Doch als Eder kurz darauf von Franziska zum Abendessen eingeladen wird, bricht er das Versprechen. Eder vertröstet den eifersüchtigen Pumuckl mit einer Tafel Schokolade. Und nimmt ihm das Versprechen ab, dass der Kobold nur im Notfall ihre Zweisamkeit im Restaurant stören wird. Doch kaum ist Eder weg, hat Pumuckl einen Notfall. Zumindest für ihn: Er bekommt die Tafel Schokolade nicht auf. Er braucht Eder! Ein unsichtbarer Kobold macht ihm Restaurant auf sich aufmerksam. Flori muss Franziska alleine lassen. Widerwillig kehrt er zurück in die Werkstatt und öffnet die Schokolade. Jetzt will er aber wirklich nicht mehr gestört werden! Doch kaum ist Eder gegangen, entdeckt Pumuckl eine Spinne. Sie sitzt auf der Schokolade! Pumuckl hat riesige Angst. Das ist nun wirklich ein Notfall! Gerade als Flori seiner Jugendliebe gesteht, nicht ungebunden zu sein, sondern einen Kobold zu haben, macht Pumuckl im Restaurant erneut auf sich aufmerksam, damit Eder ihm hilft. Als Eder in die Werkstatt kommt, scheint die Spinne verschwunden. Eder ist sauer. Pumuckl denkt sich das alles doch nur aus! Kleinlaut nimmt Flori wieder am Tisch von Franziska Platz. Schnell merkt er, dass sie ihm nicht wirklich glaubt, einen Kobold zu haben. Traurig kehrt Flori nach Hause zurück. Dort hat Pumuckl die Spinne mittlerweile mit eigenen Händen gefangen. Flori hat ein schlechtes Gewissen. Er hat Pumuckl zu Unrecht der Lüge bezichtigt. Und will sich mit einem Kaiserschmarrn zum Frühstück dafür bei ihm entschuldigen.

programme.title: Submarine Jim (23)
programme.desc: Käpt'n Jim hat eine Schleck-Manie entwickelt. Er schleckt einfach alles ab, denn dann, so denkt er, gehört es ihm. Damit schlabbert er sich aber richtig ins Abseits und fällt krankheitsbedingt aus. Plötzlich steht die große Frage im Raum: Wer übernimmt das Kommando? Siggi beruft sich sofort auf Paragrafen und Protokolle, während Bianca ganz klar findet, dass sie als beste Freundin mindestens genauso qualifiziert ist. Die Lösung? Beide werden kurzerhand Co-Kapitänin und Co-Käpt'n. Doch zwei Köpfe auf einer Brücke sorgen schnell für doppelte Befehle, dreifaches Chaos und eine Besatzung am Rande des Seetangs. Als das U-Boot schließlich auf direktem Kurs ins klebrige Teer-Verderben treibt, müssen Bianca und Siggi lernen, dass wahre Leitung nicht im Rechthaben liegt - sondern im Zusammenarbeiten. Und Jim? Der träumt sich derweil durch Fieberwellen.

programme.title: Submarine Jim (24)
programme.desc: Herr Knusperfisch - der Schwindelfisch. Serie Frankreich (2024). Jim ist begeistert von einem Werbespot für Knusperfisch, bis er erkennt, dass der sprechende Fisch lediglich ein Mensch im Kostüm ist. Diese Entdeckung erschüttert sein Vertrauen in die Welt. Zusammen mit Bianca deckt er weitere Täuschungen auf. Zwischen tanzenden Sardinen und einem U-Boot-Abenteuer lernt er schließlich, dass der Glaube an die eigene Fantasie oft wertvoller ist als die nackte Wahrheit. Darsteller: Heiko Obermöller, Fabienne Hesse, Esther Brandt, Kirstin Hesse, Amira Leisner, David M Schulze, Julian Horeyseck, Michaela Kametz, Josef Tratnik, Martin Bross, Sarah Liu, Christiane Werk, Josef Tratnik, David M Schulze, Robert Steudtner, Michaela Kametz, Dirk Hardegen, Josef Tratnik. Regie Frédéric Martin

PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten V (40)
PAW Patrol - Helfer auf vier Pfoten V (41)
Neue Geschichten vom Pumuckl (12)
programme.desc: Florians Schwester Bärbel und ihr Freund Cedric sind zu Besuch. Beim gemeinsamen Plätzchenbacken verabreden sie sich zum Skifahren. Um fünf Uhr morgens soll es los gehen. Bärbel und Cedric werden Eder pünktlich abholen. Voller Vorfreude kramt Eder seine alte Skiausrüstung hervor. Pumuckl ist begeistert. Er will mit Skifahren gehen! Eder muss abends nochmal kurz weg. Pumuckl soll aber schonmal ins Bett gehen, damit er morgen ausgeschlafen sei. Gesagt. Getan. Pumuckl stellt sogar den Wecker, nur leider auf eine falsche Uhrzeit. Als es bei Eder zu spät nach Hause kommt, fällt er todmüde ins Bett. Als dann mitten in der Nacht der Wecker klingelt, will Pumuckl unbedingt aufbrechen. Sie müssen los! Eder denkt, es sei früh am Morgen, und schleppt sich ins Bad. Pumuckl treibt ihn an. Zähneputzen, Eder! Währenddessen packt Pumuckl den Rucksack mit allerlei unnötig-wichtigen Dingen. Doch bald ist Flori im Bad eingeschlafen. Und auch Pumuckl holt die Müdigkeit ein. Als Bärbel und Cedric um fünf Uhr an der Tür klingeln, schlafen Eder und Pumuckl tief und fest. Die beiden fahren ohne sie ins Skigebiet. Als Pumuckl aufwacht, ist es bereits später Vormittag. Sie haben verschlafen! Pumuckl ist zutiefst enttäuscht. Er wollte doch so gerne Skifahren! Da kommt Eder eine Idee. Als Entschuldigung schreinert er dem Kobold ein kleines Paar Ski und baut ihm sogar einen Lift. Und so kann Pumuckl wenig später doch noch Skifahren: Auf einem kleinen Schneehügel im Innenhof.

programme.title: Scooby-Doo und wer bist Du? II (18)
Das Weihnachtskarussell - Alles dreht sich um die Liebe
The Christmas Charade - Mission Weihnachtsliebe
programme.desc: FBI-Agent Josh Dawson ist ein humorloser Einzelgänger, was bei vielen seiner Kollegen nicht gut ankommt. Er arbeitet seit sechs Monaten an einem Fall, in dem bisher sechs wertvolle Artefakte gestohlen wurden, und steht kurz davor, von seinem Vorgesetzten, Agent Michaels, aus dem Fall genommen zu werden, da er nichts vorzuweisen hat. Er erhält jedoch eine Gnadenfrist, als er in die nächste Phase seiner Ermittlungen eintritt und verdeckt ermittelt, um seinen einzigen Verdächtigen, Lou Bateman, zu treffen, dessen Frau Patty Bateman im Vorstand des New York Arts and History Museum sitzt, wo und wann er glaubt, dass das nächste Artefakt gestohlen werden wird: das Herz von Weihnachten, eine Halskette, die nur einmal im Jahr ausgestellt wird, diesmal beim Mistelzweigball am Heiligabend, der Wohltätigkeitsveranstaltung für das Museum, die von Patty organisiert wird. Wenn Josh unmittelbar nach dem Mistelzweigball keine konkreten Beweise gegen Lou Bateman vorweisen kann, wird er zu einem Schreibtischjob im sprichwörtlichen Keller versetzt. Diese Gnadenfrist gilt nur unter der Bedingung, dass er verdeckt mit einer Agentin namens Kiera Tanner zusammenarbeitet, deren Aufgabe es ist, ihn auf Kurs zu halten. Doch bei dem ersten Treffen mit den Batemans in einem Restaurant kommt es zu einer Komplikation: Anstatt Kiera sitzt Whitney mit ihm am Tisch, die ihn aufgrund einer Verwechslung für ihr Blind Date hält. Anstatt sechs Monate Arbeit zunichte zu machen, kann Josh Michaels und Whitney davon überzeugen, dass sie die Undercover-Rolle bei den Batemans übernimmt. Sie, eine Grundschulbibliothekarin, willigt ein, obwohl eine solche Arbeit Whitney, die von ihren Eltern, die eine eigene Firma für Haussicherheitstechnik besitzen, zu Risikoscheu erzogen wurde, völlig fremd ist. Whitney lebt stellvertretend durch Bücher und Filme, die ihr die größte Aufregung in ihrem ansonsten eher ruhigen Leben bieten. Die Frage ist nun, ob Whitney dieses echte Abenteuer in ihrem Leben meistern kann und ob Josh nicht nur mit einer anderen Person, sondern auch mit einer absoluten Neulingin zusammenarbeiten kann.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E30 "Richard nemůže sundat z hlavy motocyklistickou helmu, takže když přijde do banky, zděšení zaměstnanci si myslí, že je lupič, a odevzdají mu hromadu peněz. Richard odchází s penězi a vůbec mu nedochází, že právě spáchal bankovní loupež. Nicole s dětmi mu brzy vysvětlí, co provedl, a snaží se najít způsob, jak se vyhnout policejnímu stíhání a peníze vrátit."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E35 "Když Lesliemu začnou opadávat okvětní lístky, má pocit, že jeho krása uvadá. Gumball s Darwinem využijí veškerých svých znalostí o stylu a kráse, aby mu pomohli. Jediný problém je v tom, že o stylu a kráse nevědí vůbec nic. Jejich metody jsou stále extrémnější a Leslie začíná pochybovat o tom, jestli chce pro krásu obětovat všechno."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E37 "Když Wattersonovi dostanou předvolání, aby se dostavili na radnici, obávají se nejhoršího. O to více jsou příjemně překvapeni, když jim starosta nabídne nový dům. Má to ale háček: dům stojí v jiném státě! Starosta Elmoru došel k závěru, že Wattersonovi snižují cenu nemovitostí v celém městě. Pokud chtějí v Elmoru zůstat musí rodina dokázat, že patří mezi spořádané spoluobčany."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E40 "Když se pan Ribinson omylem prořekne, že mu na Gumballovi a Darwinovi nezáleží, zareagují kluci tím, že se s ním přestanou stýkat. Jenomže panu Robinsonovi se po nich překvapivě zasteskne a tak se pokouší získat si znovu jejich přátelství. Po několika neúspěšných pokusech Gumballovi a Darwinovi dojde, že pana Robinsona jeho srdce chrání před přemírou citů."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E43 "Gumballův nejlepší kamarád Chlupáč se objeví u jeho dveří. Darwin má problém smířit se s tím, že měl Gumball kamaráda i před ním a navíc nedokáže skrývat svou žárlivost. Má Darwin pravdu, když Chlupáčovi nedůvěřuje? Skutečně má Chlupáč postranní úmysly?"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E37 "Gumballovi a Darwinovi zmizí po hodině plavání oblečení, a tak si Gumball musí vzít smoking, který našel ve ztrátách a nálezech. Je přesvědčený, že v něm vypadá jako elegantní britský tajný agent a spolu s Darwinem a Bobertem vystopují padoucha, který jim ukradl oblečení."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E42 "Když se v Darwinově životě všechno pokazí, začne mít dojem, že za to může Gumballův špatný vliv. Darwin se rozhodne hledat si vzory jinde a najde si nového mentora Alana. Jenomže možná je na čase, aby se Darwin začal rozhodovat sám za sebe."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E38 "Gumball a Darwin zjistí, že dospělí obyvatelé Elmoru jsou hodně naivní, co se týká bezpečnosti na internetu. Potřebují, aby jim kluci vysvětlili alespoň ty nejzákladnější pravidla. A stejně je na tom i jejich máma Nicole."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S06E44 "Studenti Elmorské osmiletky zjistí, že jejich svět obrátil vzhůru nohama podivný školní inspektor, který chce změnit jejich způsoby. Jenomže kdo by chtěl být normální? Gumball a Darwin tedy rozhodně ne."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S01E01 Gumball a Darwin se rozhodnou svůj vztah okořenit tím, že mezi sebe přiberou třetího nejlepšího kamaráda…

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S01E02 Gumball musí zachránit život panu Robinsonovi, kterého během Elmorské talentové show pro důchodce potká nehoda!

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E32 "Ať se Gumball snaží sebevíc, Carmen má za každých okolností se svým názorem navrch. Gumball se snaží získat morální převahu, ale při tom zoufale selže. Rozhodne se, že vylepšení sebe sama není jeho styl. Zbývá mu jediná možnost, dostat Carmen na jeho úroveň."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E33 "Každý člen rodiny si myslí, že to má nejhorší. Gumball a Darwin si myslí, že nejhorší to mají kluci. Máma si myslí, že ženy. Anais si myslí, že děti a táta si myslí, že dospěláci. Dojdou k závěru, že rozhodnout jejich při může jedině to, že každý stráví den v kůži někoho jiného, bez ohledu na to, jestli je moc malý, moc velký nebo nosí podpatky."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E39 "Když děti zjistí, že se mámin život nevyvíjel přesně tak, jak doufala, snaží se jí ulehčit den tím, že jí pomůžou s domácími pracemi. Místo seznamu úkolů ale vezmou omylem seznam jejích přání a pokusí se naplnit všechny Nicoliny životní cíle."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E34 "Když máma získá cenu Zaměstnanec měsíce v Továrně na duhy, má Richard pocit, že za práci, kterou doma dělá, není dostatečně oceněn. Nicole pochybuje o tom, co všechno Richard skutečně dělá, ale když začne Richard stávkovat, je hned jasné, jak je jeho role důležitá."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S05E38 "Rodina čeká celou noc ve frontě před kinem. Jsou zdrcení, když jim Larry řekne, že se na první promítání Hvězdné odyssey nedostanou. Ale zarytí fanoušci, jako jsou Wattersonovi, jsou odhodlaní vidět film jako první, a tak se musí probojovat do čela řady."

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět

programme.desc: Souboj. Nicole navštíví záhadná postava z její minulosti a vyzve ji na souboj, ale ona k údivu svých dětí odmítne. programme.title: Gumballův báječně potrhlý svět
programme.desc: S01E04 Wattersonovi jsou normální rodinka. Táta je růžový králík a stará se o děti, zatímco máma pracuje v továrně na duhu. Nejstarší z dětí je Gumball, modrý kocour, pak je tu geniální čtyřletá králičí holčička Anais a nakonec Darwin, zlatá rybka, které narostly nohy. Hlavním hrdinou příběhů je Gumball, který se potýká se stejnými problémy a výzvami jako ostatní dvanáctiletí kluci - třeba když musí prchat před útočícím Tyrannosaurem Rexem nebo spát pod mostem, protože mu robot ukradne totožnost, nebo se má převléknout za roztleskávačku a dělat roznožky, aby udělal dojem na dívku svých snů. Vítejte v Gumballově úžasném světě, ve kterém je všechno normální tak trochu divné…

programme.desc: Test. Gumballa naštve když mu v internetovém testu opakovaně vyjde že je typ postavy zvaný Trapák. programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět IV
programme.desc: Trapas. Gumball jde stejným směrem jako Hotdog a s každým dalším krokem je jim to čím dál tím trapnější. Gumball je tak zabraný do zpívání o kečupu, že vrazí do Hotdoga. Tuhle trapnou chvilku se jim sice povede překonat, ale vzápětí zjistí, že se ubírají stejným směrem. Jejich společná cesta je čím dál tím trapnější, až se je nakonec pokusí zatknout popletený hlídač obchodu a konečně jim umožní, aby se rozešli každý za svým…

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět IV
programme.desc: Hnízdo. Obyvatelé města Elmore se záhadně ztrácejí a příčina těchto zmizení by se Gumballa s Darwinem mohla týkat víc, než si myslí. Z mimořádného zpravodajství se Wattersonovi dozvědí, že jejich soused se stal obětí jednoho ze záhadných zmizení, k nimž došlo napříč městem. Pátrání po stopách je dovede až k podivnému vejci, které, jak se brzy ukáže, patří jejich vlastní Zlé želvě. Wattersonovi si uvědomí, že nesou zodpovědnost za to, aby svého mazlíčka vystopovali, než se svými mláďaty napáchá ve městě další škody.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S04E29 "Gumball a Darwin slíbí dělat za Tobiase všechny domácí práce výměnou za ""body k dobru"". Gumball s Darwinem zjistili, že si Tobias v online hře Galaktrek vede mnohem lépe než oni. Tobias přiznal, že si plněním domácích prací pro rodiče vydělává body, které pak vyměňuje za peníze, aby si mohl koupit super vybavení pro Galaktrek. Pokud Gumball s Darwinem splní jeho povinnosti místo něj, dovolí jim získat body a použít je na Galaktrek. Gumballovi s Darwinem se zdá, že udělali terno. Ale tyhle body možná nebudou tak skvělé, jak Tobias tvrdí…"

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět IV
programme.desc: Autobus. Školní autobus je unesen, ale sami únosci byli zřejmě uneseni. Když Rocky naznačí, že děti z Elmorské osmiletky chodí za školu, autobus obsadí zločinci, kteří jim chtějí ukázat, jak je školní docházka důležitá. Maskovaní bandité jsou očividně rodiče dětí, kteří předstírají přepadení, aby jim uštědřili lekci, ale když se do toho vloží policie, je jasné, že celou situaci má pod kontrolou někdo jiný než rodiče.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět
programme.desc: S02E38 Wattersonovi jsou normální rodinka. Táta je růžový králík a stará se o děti, zatímco máma pracuje v továrně na duhu. Nejstarší z dětí je Gumball, modrý kocour, pak je tu geniální čtyřletá králičí holčička Anais a nakonec Darwin, zlatá rybka, které narostly nohy. Hlavním hrdinou příběhů je Gumball, který se potýká se stejnými problémy a výzvami jako ostatní dvanáctiletí kluci - třeba když musí prchat před útočícím Tyrannosaurem Rexem nebo spát pod mostem, protože mu robot ukradne totožnost, nebo se má převléknout za roztleskávačku a dělat roznožky, aby udělal dojem na dívku svých snů. Vítejte v Gumballově úžasném světě, ve kterém je všechno normální tak trochu divne.

programme.desc: Návrat. Když jsme se naposled setkali s Gumballem, zrovna mačkal tlačítko zpětného chodu na Robově univerzálním dálkovém ovladači, protože chtěl předejít tomu, aby uvízl ve Velké prázdnotě. Dálkové ovládání teď Gumballa zavedlo na začátek katastrofální cesty. Vyzbrojený informacemi o tom, co si pro něj daný den chystá, musí zastavit Roba a zabránit mu v tom, aby mu zničil život.

programme.desc: Kořeny. Wattersonovi se snaží Darwinovi připomenout jeho rybí kořeny. Když máma vidí, jak Darwin dlouze hledí do akvária, napadne ji, že životní styl savců jejího adoptivního syna nenaplňuje a v hloubi duše touží po návratu ke svým rybím kořenům. A tak se rodina pokusí obnovit jeho spojení s životem ve vodě. Zkusí rybí krmivo, rybí řeč a dokonce i rybí oblečení. Když nic z toho nezabere, uvědomí si, že ho možná budou muset nechat jít.

programme.desc: Obvinění. Sdružení rodičů a učitelů z Elmorské osmiletky zakáže videohry, a tak se děti snaží dokázat, že na ně videohry nemají špatný vliv. Gumball zasvětí Billyho do světa videoher, ale ten z čiré radosti omdlí. Jeho matka Felicity svolá sdružení a vyhrožuje, že zakáže videohry v celém Elmoru. Gumball s Darwinem dostanou tři příležitosti prokázat, že videohry mohou být užitečné, ale když neuspějí, rozhodnou se dokázat, že knihy mohou mít stejně zhoubný vliv.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět III
programme.desc: Štěně. Děti žadoní aby jim táta pořídil štěně jenže ten je zaskočí a přinese domů želvu. Ačkoli se ukáže že je nesmírně agresivní obzvlášť vůči Gumballovi snaží se jí rodina poskytnout láskyplný domov. Jenže bezvýsledně. Zlá želva uteče a začne řádit. Wattersonovi ji musejí najít dřív než zničí Elmore.

programme.desc: S03E05 Antonovo toustové tělíčko se rozpustí na hodině plavání. Když ho Gumball s Darwinem druhý den potkají živého a zdravého, rozhodnou se odhalit jeho tajemství. Ukáže se, že v případě potřeby si jeho rodiče podle speciálního receptu vždy upečou nového Antona. Kluci to vyzkouší doma a vytvoří celou armádu klonů, jejichž vůdce - Antuan, chce zničit Antona a ovládnout svět. / Děti žadoní, aby jim táta pořídil štěně, jenže ten je zaskočí, a přinese domů želvu. programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět VI
programme.desc: Kdokoli. Clayton se mění v různé lidi a za peníze za ně odpykává tresty. Nakonec na ně začne svalovat různé přestupky, a tak ho Darwin a Gumball musí vystopovat, aby mu v tom zabránili.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět VI
programme.desc: Párovačka. Sarah najde sešit ze super obchodu, který funguje tak, že se všechno, co do něj nakreslí, skutečně stane. Bohužel do něj začne kreslit bizarní milostné příběhy nejrůznějších obyvatel Elmoru.

programme.desc: Zakladatel. Táta způsobí zmatek v budově firmy Chanax, kde si ho spletou s místním ředitelem. Máma a nespokojení zaměstnanci pak musí všechny zachránit před Richardovými nebezpečnými nápady.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět VI
programme.desc: Lektvar. Hektor je nešťastný ze svojí výšky, a tak kluci použijí jeden z lektvarů paní Jotunheimové, aby ho zmenšili, jenomže to dopadne katastrofálně.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět VI
programme.desc: Přání. Gumball a Darwin zpanikaří, když se leknou, že omylem proměnili paní učitelku Šimpánovou na polštář tím, že pronesli přání ke kouzelné klíčence. Jejich kouzlo pak může zrušit jen vyznání pravé lásky ze strany ředitele Browna. Jak prosté!

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět VI
programme.desc: Továrna. Gumball a Darwin jdou s mámou do Továrny na duhy. Těší se, že uvidí kouzelné místo plné snů a zázraků, ale jak poznají, továrna není zdaleka tak kouzelná, jak doufali. Ale nakonec, přestože jsou tam nezvanými hosty, zachrání celou továrnu před zavřením.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět VI
programme.desc: Vzpoura. Darwin se snaží podtrhnout těžký osud všech domácích spotřebičů, které jsou podle něj ze stran obyvatel Elmoru utlačované. Pak se rozhodne vést vzpouru těchto předmětů vůči lidem.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět VI
programme.desc: Hlídání. Kluci zůstanou celou noc vzhůru, i když mají druhý den hlídat Polly, mladší sestřičku Penny. Jsou tak unavení, že během mrknutí oka Polly ztratí. Pak ji zoufale hledají, jenomže se dostávají do čí dál divnějších situací, protože mezitím upadají do spánku.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět VI
programme.desc: Cennost. Nicole se rozhodne, že je na čase vyhodit starou ledničku. Jenomže to se nelíbí Richardovi, protože jde o jeho největší cennost. Když se ukáže, že lednička je zároveň kouzelným úložným prostorem na jeho emoce a vzpomínky, je rázem jasné, proč má Richard problém se s ní rozloučit.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět VI
programme.desc: Srdce. Když se pan Ribinson omylem prořekne, že mu na Gumballovi a Darwinovi nezáleží, zareagují kluci tím, že se s ním přestanou stýkat. Jenomže panu Robinsonovi se po nich překvapivě zasteskne a tak se pokouší získat si znovu jejich přátelství. Po několika neúspěšných pokusech Gumballovi a Darwinovi dojde, že pana Robinsona jeho srdce chrání před přemírou citů.

programme.title: Gumballův úžasný svět VI
programme.desc: Kámoši. Gumballův nejlepší kamarád Chlupáč se objeví u jeho dveří. Darwin má problém smířit se s tím, že měl Gumball kamaráda i před ním a navíc nedokáže skrývat svou žárlivost. Má Darwin pravdu, když Chlupáčovi nedůvěřuje? Skutečně má Chlupáč postranní úmysly?

programme.title: Pobuda
programme.desc: Film sleduje Mikea, mladého bezdomovce žijícího v ulicích Londýna, který se snaží vymanit z koloběhu sebedestrukce.

programme.title: Líný holky
programme.desc: Po vystěhování ze squatu vyrážejí Nina a Djoul starým náklaďákem na cestu za novými dobrodružstvími, problémy i setkáními.

programme.title: Není cesty zpět
programme.desc: Po útěku z násilného vztahu se svobodná matka spřátelí s novou partnerkou svého ex a společně se snaží vymanit z jeho vlivu

programme.title: Na hraně naděje
programme.desc: Rok 1947. Helen se upíná k naději, že se její pohřešovaný syn po válce vrátí domů.

programme.title: Zkus mě rozesmát
programme.desc: Danny (Adam Sandler) je úspěšný plastický chirurg, který má opravdu nekonvenční sváděcí taktiky: předstírá, že je nešťastně ženatý. Když však potká ženu svých snů (Brooklyn Decker) svůj osvědčený příběh o nevydařeném manželství nechá u ledu a raději je sám sebou. Jenže jeho vyvolená brzy objeví jeho falešný snubní prstýnek. Danny se bojí jí říci trapnou pravdu, a tak své drahé raději namluví, že se rozvádí. Jenže ta se chce s jeho ženou setkat. A tak Dannymu nezbývá nic jiného, než požádat svou asistentku Katherine (Jennifer Aniston) o pomoc. Jenže jedna lež vede ke druhé, celá situace se pěkně zamotá a nakonec vše skončí výletem na Havaj, který jim zcela změní život.

programme.title: Ad Astra
programme.desc: Brad Pitt předvádí úžasný herecký výkon v tomto sci-fi thrilleru, který se odehrává hluboko ve vesmíru. Když tajemné události začnou ohrožovat život na Zemi, astronaut Roy McBride (Pitt) musí vyrazit na nebezpečnou misi napříč nemilosrdnou sluneční soustavou, aby odhalil pravdu o svém otci (Tommy Lee Jones) a jeho expedici, která se před 30 lety ztratila kdesi ve vesmíru.

programme.title: Vévodkyně
programme.desc: Aristokratka Georgiana Cavendishová, vévodkyně z Devonshiru (Keira Knightley) žila v 18. století a na svou dobu byla pokrokovou ženou. Byla úchvatná, oslňující, charismatická, okouzlující a obdivovaná celou zemí. Její chování bylo ale společensky nepřijatelné: míchala se do politiky, což se u žen neslušelo, navíc našla zalíbení v hazardu. I když její moc a popularita rostly, v osobním životě radost nenacházela. Nešťastné manželství s citově chladným vévodou z Devonshiru (Ralph Fiennes), jediným mužem v Anglii, kterému nedokázala učarovat, si okořenila milostnými aférkami s mladým politikem. Výsledkem byl chaos a vztahy tak spletité, že o nich mluvil celý Londýn.
